scientific_interpretation: The archived pairwise geometry covers 402 ponds, but annual water availability/unavailability is supplied only for 95 ponds, exactly matching the publicly known set of ponds occupied at least once during 1976-2019. A fresh binary colonization benchmark restricted to those 95 ponds would therefore condition the prediction universe on future response. The 307 geometry-only ponds cannot be silently treated as available, surveyed, unoccupied, or negative because their annual availability/survey state is not archived in the response-free water table.

response_semantics_supported_within_95.note: These semantics are well-defined for the archived 95-pond subset but do not cure future-response selection of that subset.

no_rescue_boundary: Do not use only the 95 ever-occupied ponds and call the result a fresh binary validation.
Do not assign missing water/availability states to the 307 geometry-only ponds.
Do not treat geometry-only ponds as surveyed negatives.
Do not inspect colony outcomes to reconstruct the missing node universe.
Do not change to a positive-only endpoint and relabel it as the frozen Layer-B validation.
eog_evidence: none; candidate stopped before colony-response access and before Layer-B prediction
